newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd says Saudi Arabia welcomes Iraq's acceptance of U.N. terms for an oil-for-food deal to help end the suffering of the Iraqi people.
- Rain inflicts 90 million riyals in losses on Jeddah.
- The higher committee for Riyadh's development endorsed projects worth 989 million riyals at a meeting on Sunday.
- Tabouk municipality chairman says 30 percent of a 40 million riyals water project is completed.
- Arabic Oil Compamy will increase the salaries of its employees as of January 1997.
